exact_claim: Advanced AI systems may benefit from an explicit, inspectable, cost-bounded, source-aware, revisable responsibility for deciding what context influences generation.
counterevidence: Existing systems may compose the same functions without a distinct layer; no comparative evaluation exists.
dependency: Historical recovery; operational definition; controlled comparison

exact_claim: Information acquisition and additional computation have costs that can rationally affect whether to continue searching.
source: Howard 1966; Russell and Wefald 1991; Pirolli and Card 1999
scope: Decision analysis, metareasoning, and information foraging
counterevidence: Utilities and costs can be misspecified; risk-sensitive exceptions matter.
dependency: Defined decision, cost, uncertainty, and utility

exact_claim: Relevance feedback can alter a retrieval query using judgments about relevant and non-relevant material.
counterevidence: Relevance remains task-relative and feedback can reinforce a mistaken frame.
dependency: Explicit information need and feedback signal

exact_claim: Assessing a source and assessing the content communicated by that source are distinguishable processes.
counterevidence: The processes interact and source cues can dominate content judgment.
dependency: Defined source, message, and decision context

exact_claim: A long response may contain multiple atomic claims with different evidence-support states.
counterevidence: Open-world sources, temporal change, and contested claims remain harder than benchmark corpora.
dependency: Atomic claim definition and named evidence corpus

exact_claim: Provenance establishes lineage relationships but does not by itself establish factual correctness.
counterevidence: Complete lineage can faithfully preserve false content.
dependency: Stable source and artifact identity

exact_claim: Repeated reports should not automatically be counted as independent evidence when they share a common underlying origin.
scope: Evidence synthesis; analogical extension to source recurrence
counterevidence: Different reports may add distinct information; common origin may be uncertain.
dependency: Report-to-origin relationship analysis

exact_claim: A first-party source can strongly support a narrow claim about what that party officially said, released, or recorded without independently validating effectiveness or superiority.
counterevidence: First-party records may be incomplete, changed, or deceptive; independent outcome claims need separate support.
dependency: Exact atomic claim and source role

exact_claim: Attention priority is not a factual conclusion.
source: Information retrieval, mixed initiative, and Signal Foundry boundary docs
counterevidence: Poorly designed priority signals can still be interpreted as endorsement.
dependency: Visible reason and non-claiming label

exact_claim: A larger context does not guarantee that a language model will use all relevant information uniformly.
scope: Evaluated long-context language models and tasks
counterevidence: Behavior varies by model, task, and later improvements.
dependency: Model/version/task-specific evaluation

exact_claim: Retrieval-augmented generation is established prior art for conditioning generation on retrieved external information.
counterevidence: RAG does not solve source reliability, independence, or open-world verification.
dependency: Retriever, corpus, and generator definition

exact_claim: Source-reliability-aware RAG and retrieved-document attribution have already been proposed.
source: Hwang et al. 2025; Nematov et al. 2025 preprint
scope: Published RA-RAG paper and one attribution preprint
counterevidence: Agreement-based reliability can fail under dependent sources; attribution does not prove truth.
dependency: Independent evaluation and dependence model

exact_claim: Agent-memory systems already implement retention, retrieval, reflection, links, temporal organization, and fact/opinion distinctions.
scope: Named systems and their reported architectures
counterevidence: System-author claims and benchmark performance require independent replication; memory can propagate errors.
dependency: Task-specific memory evaluation

exact_claim: Human review and mixed initiative require explicit uncertainty, timing, correction, and control design.
counterevidence: Guidelines do not guarantee safe implementation and may not transfer unchanged across domains.
dependency: Defined human role and evaluable interaction

exact_claim: Confidence should be evaluated against observed correctness rather than treated as a decorative score.
counterevidence: Calibration can drift across distributions and does not cover authority or utility.
dependency: Held-out outcomes and model/version scope

exact_claim: Coordinated or copied sources can manufacture apparent recurrence.
source: Meta CIB reports; Banerjee 1992; Cochrane duplicate-report guidance
counterevidence: Authentic coordination and genuine convergence also exist; platform definitions are policy-specific.
dependency: Common-origin and coordination evidence

exact_claim: Signal Foundry can illustrate bounded intake, identity, provenance, evidence-class separation, enrichment selection, receipts, and human review.
counterevidence: Current implementation may differ; documentation is partly aspirational and product-specific.
dependency: Exact source-artifact links in final case study

exact_claim: Alpha Solver can illustrate routing, clarification, refusal, evidence-bounded response posture, replay, and budget controls.
source: Committed Alpha Solver README and evaluation-design packets
scope: Read-only architecture and unexecuted/limited evaluation artifacts
counterevidence: The inspected discrimination packets do not establish measured comparative value or production readiness.
dependency: Exact source-artifact links in final case study

exact_claim: Alpha Solver or Signal Foundry validates the full discrimination-layer framework.
counterevidence: Both projects are related implementation contexts and cannot provide independent proof.
dependency: Independent empirical evaluation

exact_claim: The framework is enterprise-ready or enterprise-validated.
source: No authorized pilot or validation evidence
counterevidence: Plausible requirements and use cases are not readiness evidence.
dependency: Authorized pilots; security, privacy, and outcome evaluation

exact_claim: Separating authority, claim support, independence, relevance, attention, and action improves decision quality.
counterevidence: The dimensions may be unusable, redundant, or too costly.
dependency: Operational definitions; baseline; controlled or longitudinal study

exact_claim: The phrase discrimination layer communicates the intended technical meaning without material misunderstanding.
counterevidence: The term has strong social and legal meanings and may mislead or alienate readers.
dependency: Reader testing and owner decision

exact_claim: V13 places the main leverage for less-generic AI work in pattern recognition and discrimination applied to inputs before generation.
counterevidence: Historical presence does not establish effectiveness; retrieval and generation interact.
dependency: Live-site recovery receipt; exact standalone bytes pending

exact_claim: V13 explicitly states that peripheral or underweighted material is not necessarily true and pairs it with convergence, source weighting, and outcome validation.
counterevidence: The proposed checks are themselves fallible and do not establish truth.
dependency: Operational definitions; evidence standards; common-origin analysis

exact_claim: V13 organizes its system into peripheral signal mining, source weighing, velocity, absence and memory, structured patterns, and a learning loop.
source: Owner-designated live v13 reference and rendered diagram
counterevidence: The family boundaries mix acquisition strategies, analytical operations, state, and feedback; the center may not generalize.
dependency: Framework reconciliation and reader testing

exact_claim: V13 treats recurrence across distinct ecosystems as stronger than many mentions within one ecosystem.
counterevidence: Different ecosystems can copy one origin or share incentives; ecosystem diversity is not demonstrated independence.
dependency: Report-to-origin tracing and uncertainty state

exact_claim: V13 proposes weighting sources using recorded originality, accuracy, and lead-time track records.
counterevidence: Track records can be selected retrospectively, drift, vary by claim type, and conflate authority with support.
dependency: Prospective scoring rule; domain scope; outcomes; calibration and drift tests

exact_claim: V13 proposes velocity relative to a cohort or historical baseline as an early attention signal.
counterevidence: Velocity may reflect manipulation, measurement change, seasonality, or noise and is not a forecast or truth signal.
dependency: Repeated timestamped observations; baseline; contamination tests; defined action

exact_claim: V13 proposes detecting conspicuous absence by comparing observed material with an expected peer or longitudinal baseline.
source: Owner-designated live v13 reference cards 05 and 10
counterevidence: Missing collection, access, observation, or disclosure can masquerade as real-world absence.
dependency: Explicit authorized observation boundary and typed expected baseline

exact_claim: V13 proposes normalized comparison across a measurable peer population to identify recurring attributes and target gaps.
counterevidence: Success metrics can be confounded; populations incomplete; correlation does not identify which gap would cause improvement.
dependency: Sampling frame; normalization specification; outcome definition; causal humility

exact_claim: V13 proposes structured longitudinal memory for tested, ruled-out, recurring, untried, and missing information.
counterevidence: Later memory systems already implement related structures; stored errors, sensitive data, and stale interpretations can propagate.
dependency: Prior-art attribution; provenance; retention; correction and staleness rules

exact_claim: V13 places a learning loop over the other mechanisms to update source weights, baselines, probes, and frames from later outcomes.
counterevidence: Outcomes can be absent, delayed, confounded, selectively recorded, adversarial, or preference-laden.
dependency: Predefined outcome; measurement window; immutable prior; human-approved update

exact_claim: V13 presents process, intermediary reasoning, and custom-model paths as three possible implementation approaches.
counterevidence: The paths are not exhaustive or mutually exclusive and no comparative evidence establishes their hierarchy.
dependency: Task-specific requirements and comparative implementation study

exact_claim: V13 claims the main novelty is treating established mechanisms as standard operating discipline rather than research-team specialty work.
counterevidence: No systematic practice survey establishes adoption or absence; many established workflows already operationalize subsets.
dependency: Systematic prior-art and practice review; adoption evidence

exact_claim: V13 suggests encoding decomposable expert pattern-recognition practices can raise the floor of non-expert output while leaving non-decomposable judgment to experts.
counterevidence: Expertise is not reducible to output appearance; automation can increase overconfidence; no expert comparison exists.
dependency: Bounded task; expert reference; controlled outcome and reliance evaluation

exact_claim: V13 broadly states that default GPT cannot perform several corpus-scale retrieval, comparison, memory, and weighting operations.
counterevidence: Capabilities depend on model, tools, retrieval, corpus access, memory, prompting, and date; blanket claims are unstable.
dependency: Named baseline configuration and current evaluation

exact_claim: V13 says AI-building participation expanded by orders of magnitude and that the model layer is commoditizing faster than expected.
counterevidence: No measure, period, population, cost basis, or expectation baseline is supplied.
dependency: Independent time-bounded market evidence if the claim is necessary

exact_claim: The live v13 mobile layout is usable at a 390 by 844 viewport.
source: Direct visual inspection of owner-designated live v13 reference
counterevidence: The introductory text collapses into an extremely narrow column with one or a few words per line.
dependency: Responsive v14 redesign and browser QA
